rows.grounds: ekībhūtaṃ = become-one (past participle, neuter nominative singular)
vibhātyatra = shines-here (vibhāti: 3rd singular present active of √bhā; atra: indeclinable)
jagadetaccarācaram = this-world-moving-unmoving (sandhi: jagat + etat + carācaram; compound/dvandva-like apposition)
grāhyagrāhakabhedo = object-subject-difference (tatpuruṣa compound: grāhya-grāhaka-bhedaḥ, nominative singular masculine)
kiṃcidatreṣyate = something-here-is-expected (kiṃcit: indeclinable; atra: indeclinable; iṣyate: 3rd singular present passive of √iṣ)
